professor_teklovossen.text_zh:
每有一位对手英雄，进化牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
你可以从你的放逐区使用进化牌。
professor_teklovossen.text_en:
Evos cost {r} less to play for each opposing hero.
You may play Evos from your banished zone.

puffin.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个金币：创造一个金齿轮衍生物。
你每回合第二次上弦时，抽一张牌。
puffin.text_en:
Action - {t}, destroy a Gold you control: Create a Golden Cog token.
The second time you crank each turn, draw a card.

puffin_hightail.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个金币：创造一个金齿轮衍生物。
你每回合第二次上弦时，抽一张牌。
puffin_hightail.text_en:
Action - {t}, destroy a Gold you control: Create a Golden Cog token.
The second time you crank each turn, draw a card.

reya_the_unyielding.text_zh:
你拥有的防御值和防御为1或更高的装备获得守护。
每当你守护另一位英雄时，创造一个金币衍生物。
reya_the_unyielding.text_en:
Block cards you own and equipment you control with 1 or greater {d} get protect.
Whenever you protect another hero, create a Gold token.

rhinar.text_zh: 每当你在你的行动阶段期间弃置一张力量为6或更高的牌时，威吓。
rhinar.text_en: Whenever you discard a card with 6 or more {p} during your action phase, intimidate.

rhinar_reckless_rampage.text_zh: 每当你在你的行动阶段期间弃置一张力量为6或更高的牌时，威吓。
rhinar_reckless_rampage.text_en: Whenever you discard a card with 6 or more {p} during your action phase, intimidate.

riptide.text_zh:
每当你从手牌使用牌时，你可以将手牌中的一张牌牌面朝下放入你的军械库。
每当你控制的陷阱触发时，对攻击英雄造成1点伤害。
riptide.text_en:
Whenever you play a card from hand, you may put a card from hand face down into your arsenal.
Whenever a trap you control triggers, deal 1 damage to the attacking hero.

riptide_lurker_of_the_deep.text_zh:
每当你从手牌使用牌时，你可以将手牌中的一张牌牌面朝下放入你的军械库。
每当你控制的陷阱触发时，对攻击英雄造成1点伤害。
riptide_lurker_of_the_deep.text_en:
Whenever you play a card from hand, you may put a card from hand face down into your arsenal.
Whenever a trap you control triggers, deal 1 damage to the attacking hero.

ruudi_gem_keeper.text_zh:
你的牌库中只能包含经过PSA评级的牌。
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为评级Gem Mint 10的牌，将其置入你的手牌。否则，每位对手可以抽一张牌。再动
ruudi_gem_keeper.text_en:
You may only have PSA graded cards in your deck.
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's graded Gem Mint 10, put it into your hand, otherwise each opponent may draw a card. Go again

scurv_stowaway.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个金币：创造一个金吻朗姆酒衍生物。再动
每当你启动金吻朗姆酒时，获得1点资源。
scurv_stowaway.text_en:
Action - {t}, destroy a Gold you control: Create a Goldkiss Rum token. Go again
Whenever you activate a Goldkiss Rum, gain {r}.

ser_boltyn_breaker_of_dawn.text_zh:
若本回合你充能过，当你的攻击被攻击行动牌防御时，它们获得+1力量。
攻击反应——放逐博尔廷灵魂中的一张牌：目标力量大于其基础力量的攻击获得再动。
ser_boltyn_breaker_of_dawn.text_en:
If you've charged this turn, your attacks get +1{p} while defended by an attack action card.
Attack Reaction - Banish a card from Boltyn's soul: Target attack with {p} greater than its base {p} gains go again.

shiyana_diamond_gemini.text_zh:
你的牌库中可以包含任意英雄的专精牌。
在你的行动阶段开始时，希亚娜成为目标英雄的复制品直到你的下一个回合开始，并获得"你拥有的牌除其原有职业类别外还视为你的英雄的职业。"
shiyana_diamond_gemini.text_en:
You may have specialization cards of any hero in your deck.
At the beginning of your action phase, Shiyana becomes a copy of target hero until the start of your next turn, and gains "Cards you own are the class of your hero in addition to their other class types."

squizzy_floof.text_zh: 在每位对手英雄的回合开始时，该英雄可以在其手牌中创造一个破裂饰物。若该英雄如此做，你创造一个金币衍生物。
squizzy_floof.text_en: At the start of each opposing hero's turn, they may create a Cracked Bauble in their hand. If they do, you create a Gold token.

taipanis_dracai_of_judgement.text_zh: 每回合第一次另一位英雄成为将造成致命伤害的来源的目标时，你可以弃一张红色牌。若如此做，为那个来源选择新的目标。
taipanis_dracai_of_judgement.text_en: The first time each turn another hero becomes the target of a source that would deal lethal damage, you may discard a red card. If you do, choose new targets for that source.

taylor.text_zh:
你的物品栏中可以包含任意职业或才能的装备。你起始物品栏中的每件装备必须具有不同名称。
在你的回合开始时，你可以放逐你控制的一件装备。若如此做，装备你物品栏中一张相同副类别的牌。
taylor.text_en:
You may have equipment of any class or talent in your inventory. Each equipment in your starting inventory must have a different name.
At the start of your turn, you may banish an equipment you control. If you do, equip a card of the same subtype from your inventory.

teklovossen.text_zh:
你可以从你的放逐区使用进化牌。
每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：本回合你可以将你的下一张进化牌当作瞬间使用。当你如此做时，抽一张牌。
teklovossen.text_en:
You may play Evos from your banished zone.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}{r}: You may play your next Evo this turn as though it were an instant. When you do, draw a card.

teklovossen_esteemed_magnate.text_zh:
你可以从你的放逐区使用进化牌。
每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：本回合你可以将你的下一张进化牌当作瞬间使用。当你如此做时，抽一张牌。
teklovossen_esteemed_magnate.text_en:
You may play Evos from your banished zone.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}{r}: You may play your next Evo this turn as though it were an instant. When you do, draw a card.

terra.text_zh:
在每个结束阶段开始时，若你资源区中有一张大地牌，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，创造一个力量衍生物。
大地精华
terra.text_en:
At the beginning of each end phase, if there is an Earth card in your pitch zone, you may pay {r}. If you do, create a Might token.
Essence of Earth

the_librarian_magister_of_history.name_zh: 历史首席学者·图书管理员
the_librarian_magister_of_history.text_zh:
你的牌库中可以包含任意职业或才能的名称为典籍的牌。
行动——横置此牌，展示你物品栏中的一张名称为典籍的牌：将其置入你的手牌。另一位目标英雄直到其下一个回合结束获得+1智力。再动
the_librarian_magister_of_history.text_en:
You may have cards with Tome in their name of any class or talent in your deck.
Action - {t}, reveal a card with Tome in its name from your inventory: Put it into your hand. Another target hero gets +1{i} until the end of their next turn. Go again

theryon_magister_of_justice.text_zh: 每回合第一次另一位英雄摧毁一张其不控制的牌时，你可以支付2点资源。若如此做，该英雄摧毁其控制的一个非英雄永久物。
theryon_magister_of_justice.text_en: The first time each turn another hero destroys a card they don't control, you may pay {r}{r}. If you do, they destroy a non-hero permanent they control.

tuffnut.text_zh:
瞬间——横置此牌：资源你牌库顶的一张牌。若其力量为6或更高，观众为你欢呼。
每当观众为你欢呼时，创造一个坚韧衍生物。
tuffnut.text_en:
Instant - {t}: Pitch the top card of your deck. If it has 6 or more {p}, the crowd cheers you.
Whenever the crowd cheers you, create a Toughness token.

tuffnut_bumbling_hulkster.text_zh:
瞬间——横置此牌：资源你牌库顶的一张牌。若其力量为6或更高，观众为你欢呼。
每当观众为你欢呼时，创造一个坚韧衍生物。
tuffnut_bumbling_hulkster.text_en:
Instant - {t}: Pitch the top card of your deck. If it has 6 or more {p}, the crowd cheers you.
Whenever the crowd cheers you, create a Toughness token.

uzuri.text_zh: 每回合一次攻击反应——牌面朝下放逐你手牌中的一张牌：将以此方式放逐的牌翻为正面朝上。若其为费用为2或更低的攻击行动牌，将当前链环上目标具有隐匿的攻击牌置于其拥有者的牌库底，然后将被放逐的牌作为攻击牌放入当前链环。
uzuri.text_en: Once per Turn Attack Reaction - Banish a card from your hand face down: Turn the card banished this way face up. If it's an attack action card with cost 2 or less, put target attacking card with stealth from the active chain link on the bottom of its owner's deck, then put the banished card onto the active chain link as the attacking card.

uzuri_switchblade.text_zh: 每回合一次攻击反应——牌面朝下放逐你手牌中的一张牌：将以此方式放逐的牌翻为正面朝上。若其为费用为2或更低的攻击行动牌，将当前链环上目标具有隐匿的攻击牌置于其拥有者的牌库底，然后将被放逐的牌作为攻击牌放入当前链环。
uzuri_switchblade.text_en: Once per Turn Attack Reaction - Banish a card from your hand face down: Turn the card banished this way face up. If it's an attack action card with cost 2 or less, put target attacking card with stealth from the active chain link on the bottom of its owner's deck, then put the banished card onto the active chain link as the attacking card.

valda_brightaxe.text_zh:
每当行动阶段期间对手抽牌时，每有一张以此方式抽的牌，创造一个地震涌动衍生物。
在你的回合开始时，若你控制3个或更多地震涌动衍生物，本回合你拥有的具有粉碎的牌获得支配。
valda_brightaxe.text_en:
Whenever an opponent draws a card during an action phase, create a Seismic Surge token for each card drawn this way.
At the start of your turn, if you control 3 or more Seismic Surge tokens, cards you own with crush gain dominate this turn.

valda_seismic_impact.text_zh:
每当行动阶段期间对手抽1张或更多牌时，创造等量的地震涌动衍生物。
在你的回合开始时，若你控制3个或更多地震涌动衍生物，本回合你拥有的具有粉碎的牌获得支配。
valda_seismic_impact.text_en:
Whenever an opponent draws 1 or more cards during an action phase, create that many Seismic Surge tokens.
At the start of your turn, if you control 3 or more Siesmic Surge tokens, cards you own with crush get dominate this turn.

verdance.text_zh:
若你的放逐区有四张或更多大地牌，沃丹斯获得"每当你在你的回合期间获得生命时，你可以对任意对手目标造成1点秘法伤害。"
大地精华
verdance.text_en:
If there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, Verdance gets "Whenever you gain {h} during your turn, you may deal 1 arcane damage to any opposing target."
Essence of Earth

verdance_thorn_of_the_rose.text_zh:
若你的放逐区有8张或更多大地牌，沃丹斯获得“每当你在你的回合期间获得生命时，你可以对任意对手目标造成1点秘法伤害。”
大地精华
verdance_thorn_of_the_rose.text_en:
If there are 8 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, Verdance gets "Whenever you gain {h} during your turn, you may deal 1 arcane damage to any opposing target."
Essence of Earth

victor_goldmane.text_zh:
每回合第一次你因自己控制的效果创造金币衍生物时，抽一张牌。
每回合第一次你将未能赢得交锋时，你可以改为摧毁你控制的一个金币。若如此做，将展示的牌中的一张置于其拥有者的牌库底，然后再次交锋。
victor_goldmane.text_en:
The first time each turn you create a Gold token from an effect you control, draw a card.
The first time each turn you would fail to win a clash, instead you may destroy a Gold you control. If you do, put 1 of the revealed cards on the bottom of its owner's deck, then clash again.

victor_goldmane_high_and_mighty.text_zh:
每回合第一次你因自己控制的效果创造金币衍生物时，抽一张牌。
每回合第一次你将未能赢得交锋时，你可以改为摧毁你控制的一个金币。若如此做，将展示的牌中的一张置于其拥有者的牌库底，然后再次交锋。
victor_goldmane_high_and_mighty.text_en:
The first time each turn you create a Gold token from an effect you control, draw a card.
The first time each turn you would fail to win a clash, instead you may destroy a Gold you control. If you do, put 1 of the revealed cards on the bottom of its owner's deck, then clash again.

victor_goldmane_match_fixer.name_zh: 维克托·金鬃·比赛操纵者
victor_goldmane_match_fixer.text_zh:
瞬间——横置此牌：选择一位对手。本回合该英雄为其下一次交锋展示的第一张牌获得+1力量。当其赢得那次交锋时，你创造一个金币衍生物。
每当你攻击时，你可以摧毁你控制的3个金币。若如此做，该攻击获得+3力量和支配。
victor_goldmane_match_fixer.text_en:
Instant - {t}: Choose an opponent. The first card they reveal for their next clash this turn gets +1{p}. When they win that clash, you create a Gold token.
Whenever you attack, you may destroy 3 Gold you control. If you do, the attack gets +3{p} and dominate.

viserai.text_zh: 每当你使用符文剑士牌时，若本回合你使用过另一张非攻击行动牌，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
viserai.text_en: Whenever you play a Runeblade card, if you have played another 'non-attack' action card this turn, create a Runechant token.

viserai_rune_blood.text_zh: 每当你使用符文剑士牌时，若本回合你使用过另一张非攻击行动牌，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
viserai_rune_blood.text_en: Whenever you play a Runeblade card, if you've played another non-attack action card this turn, create a Runechant token.

vynnset.text_zh:
在你的回合开始时，放逐你手牌中的一张牌。若如此做，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
每当你使用暗影非攻击行动牌时，你可以支付生命。若如此做，本回合下一个将造成伤害的符文吟唱效果不能被防止。
vynnset.text_en:
At the start of your turn, banish a card from your hand. If you do, create a Runechant token.
Whenever you play a Shadow non-attack action card, you may pay {h}. If you do, the next Runechant effect that would deal damage this turn can't be prevented.

vynnset_iron_maiden.text_zh:
在你的回合开始时，放逐你手牌中的一张牌。若如此做，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
每当你使用暗影非攻击行动牌时，你可以支付生命。若如此做，本回合下一个将造成伤害的符文吟唱效果不能被防止。
vynnset_iron_maiden.text_en:
At the start of your turn, banish a card from your hand. If you do, create a Runechant token.
Whenever you play a Shadow non-attack action card, you may pay {h}. If you do, the next Runechant effect that would deal damage this turn can't be prevented.

yoji_royal_protector.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：本回合另一位目标英雄下一次将受到伤害时，改为该伤害对约吉造成并防止其中1点伤害。
yoji_royal_protector.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}{r}: The next time another target hero would be dealt damage this turn, instead that damage is dealt to Yoji and prevent 1 of that damage.

yorick_weaver_of_tales.text_zh: 在游戏开始时，所有英雄将他们的起始牌库洗在一起。本场游戏中所有英雄共用同一牌库和坟场。
yorick_weaver_of_tales.text_en: At the start of the game, all heroes shuffle their starting decks together. All heroes share the same deck and graveyard this game.

zen.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：在你的手牌中创造一张卧虎。从你的牌库中搜寻一张具有连击的牌，放逐它，然后洗牌。本回合你可以使用它。
zen.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {c}{c}{c}: Create a Crouching Tiger in your hand. Search your deck for a card with combo, banish it, then shuffle. You may play it this turn.

zen_tamer_of_purpose.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：在你的手牌中创造一张卧虎。从你的牌库中搜寻一张具有连击的牌，放逐它，然后洗牌。本回合你可以使用它。
zen_tamer_of_purpose.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {c}{c}{c}: Create a Crouching Tiger in your hand. Search your deck for a card with combo, banish it, then shuffle. You may play it this turn.

zyggy.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源，横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个闪电流转，放逐你控制的另一个没有全息指示物的闪电光环永久物：将被放逐的光环带有一个全息指示物地移回竞技场。
zyggy.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}, {t}, destroy a Lightning Flow you control, banish another Lightning aura permanent you control with no holo counters: Return the banished aura to the arena with a holo counter.

zyggy_starlight.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源，横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个闪电流转，放逐你控制的另一个没有全息指示物的闪电光环永久物：将被放逐的光环带有一个全息指示物地移回竞技场。
zyggy_starlight.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}, {t}, destroy a Lightning Flow you control, banish another Lightning aura permanent you control with no holo counters: Return the banished aura to the arena with a holo counter.
